question: Should this PR become the canonical agent-core descriptor-hardening branch, or should one of the overlapping drafts own the combined fix?
rationale: The fix direction is sound, but the branch is protected, conflicting with current resolver behavior, and overlaps three open maintainer drafts, so automation cannot safely choose scope or conflict strategy.

options.title: Rebase This Branch Through Current Resolver

options.title: Promote A Sibling Draft
